## Summary

What this PR changes and why, in one or two sentences.

## Field evidence

The run (or reasoning, for pure docs fixes) that justifies the change. For
rule changes: describe the scenario where the old rule failed or the new one
proved itself.

## Checklist

- [ ] Change is written in English; `README.zh-CN.md` updated if user-facing
- [ ] `npx markdownlint-cli2` passes locally
- [ ] `npx prettier --check .` passes locally
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] No modifications under `third-party/diagram-design/` except
      re-vendoring from upstream
